name: RRCC
description: Training command center — readiness scoring, sleep and heart-rate signals, weekly load, and an AI coach plan in plain English.

name: FULLGAS
description: Competitive cycling with GPS hotspots, a garage, and leaderboards. The apex won't wait.

name: DashCam
description: An AI dashcam — live road-sign and signal detection, speed, g-force, GPS lock, and one-tap clip tagging while you drive.

name: Flight Facts
description: Window-seat companion. Detects your flight mid-air and narrates what you're flying over — landmarks, geology, oddities. Works in airplane mode.

name: Conference Assist
description: A command center for working a conference — playbook, badge-scan contacts, AI enrichment, and readiness tracking from gate to gate.

name: AI Assessment Scorecard
description: Eight dimensions, five taps each — turns an AI-readiness conversation into a score out of 100 and a verdict on the spot.

name: MCP Qualifier
description: "Should this be an MCP?" Type or speak the use case, get a scored verdict: skip it, use a workflow tool, build one MCP — or several.

name: Manufacturing Assist
description: Plant-ops AI assistant — equipment troubleshooting, OEE reports, safety incidents, inventory, quality, and shift handoffs in one thread list.

name: Apple Health Exporter
description: One tap pulls the day's Apple Health and motion data into clean JSON — with a daily reminder so the streak never breaks.

name: Outdoor Tracker
description: Hike, walk, run, ride — live activity tracking with spot heart-rate readings, replay, and a watch-live map for people back home.

name: Altitude & G-Force Checker
description: Ride replay from every sensor on the phone — altitude, g-force, vibration, smoothness scoring, and the weather while it happened.

name: Keylight
description: Turns the biggest screen in the room into a key light — presets, light shapes, color temperature, and brightness, tuned from the couch.
